Freight rates

Matrix name 2026 and its lanes

A centered note under the matrix

A card with its own padding

Rates come from the matrix each carrier sends us. A lane keeps the rate it was quoted at until the quote expires. A person in sales can change it by hand on the lane.

A lane with no rate in the matrix shows a dash. Its quote waits for a rate before it can be sent to the customer. The quote's page says so at the top.

Each lane lists its port of loading and its port of discharge. The rate under them is the one the carrier sent last. Older rates stay in the history.
A quote shows the rate at the time it was made. Sales can see the newer rate beside it. They choose which one the customer sees.
